name: VIP Entertainment Technologies Inc.
summary: Established in 2016 and headquartered in Calgary, Canada, VIP Entertainment Technologies Inc. functions as an operator of online sports betting platforms. Through its primary VIP Bets platform, the company delivers a variety of gaming options, including sports betting, casino games, and poker. Furthermore, it provides daily fantasy sports products and manages vipfree2play.com, a free-to-play gaming platform.
